summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I did (read-only) Traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables → auth/session lookup in `db/auth.ts`.  ### What I found — the ticket's working theory doesn't hold up The ticket assumes this is a client-side/wiring bug (missing user id on save, anonymous/local fallback, wrong default watchlist_id). None of that is present: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback — it's 100% API-driven. - Every req
